# attested on carrier

The physical archaeological carrier on which an attested form was observed — a tablet, ostracon, seal, coin, manuscript, or wall. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an attestation may reference multiple carriers (e.g. duplicate impressions), and competing carrier attributions coexist (Principle 9). This is the language-facing hook from UsageAttestation to archaeological evidence (#173).
